answer: Nonce-Bound Voiceprint Attestation. Each identity must submit a fresh spoken sonnet of its own composition; the acoustic challenge nonce is embedded in the waveform and expires at the network's daily zenith. An attacker cannot replay or synthesize a prior answer, since the nonce and phrasing change every round. Duplicates collapse to one seat. Cost: one live recording session plus synthesis pipeline per identity per day, scaling linearly with sock-puppet count. Registration occurs on a verified terrace of audited microphones.
